notes.title: Level Select and Art Gallery: v1.2 Out Now! + OST Coming Soon
notes.content:
Firstly, thank you to everyone for your support towards Beetle Roller! As of writing, the game has 20 reviews with the game at a Positive rating - something we could've never expected for what started as a small student project. But let's get on with it!

New Features

Level Select

https://i.imgur.com/x5Fmnjm.gif

Due to popular demand! You can access this new menu from the title screen. Levels unlock when you've cleared the previous one. Here you can see your collection of rank medals as well as your best recorded time.

Art Gallery

https://i.imgur.com/CjZ7LzO.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603677/8a88c1ea082255aa8eaebb7e2fceb7e48a3252f7.png

Explore 50+ pieces of development sketches, concept art, illustrations, model wireframes, screenshots and more! A plethora of content for TRUE BEETLE Roller fans, or just those curious about the development process! The Gallery is unlocked on the title screen after beating the game for the first time with any rank.

Updates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603677/9cdb7f0bdd4f24115caeb98e3be4196866cdfeaa.png


 Icons have been added to every button in the game to hopefully help with accessibility for players of other languages.
 Added a "NEW BEST TIME!" notification to the level clear screen.
 Several small UI tweaks, notably button visuals and the level clear screen.


Technical Changes

Save Data

A save system has been added to the game to keep track of player level progression, ranks, and best times. Returning players will have rank data assigned to them based off of their highest ranking game completion achievement. (Ex: Players with the ANGSTY ANT achievement will be assigned all Silver medals with 10/10 levels unlocked on the Level Select menu.) Returning players with any game completion achievement will also be able to access the Gallery right away.

https://i.imgur.com/jVE3nNn.gif

Use the big red button at the end of the Settings menu to delete your save and start a fresh run of the game!

GO! GO! Beetle Roller! ~ Original Soundtrack

[previewyoutube=qlgscxxeq6I;full][/previewyoutube]

The OST for Beetle Roller will be available on Steam very soon! It features all seven tracks from the game, as well as a bonus extended version of Beetle Roller's Theme. Check it out to support our composer!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3755290/

Closing

And that's all! Thanks once again for your support on Beetle Roller, and we hope you enjoy these updates. Keep it rollin!
